## Prerequisites

Install `arsgrammatica`:

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/neelsmith/arsgrammatica.git
```

Configure your language model in a `.env` file  ilke this:

```bash
API_BASE=https://serviceprovider
MODEL=litellm_proxy/Claude Opus 5
API_KEY=your_key
```
